## Who he is

Sofonias Mengistu is a Cloud Platform Architect and Cloud DevOps engineer for hire. He is based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (Africa Avenue, postal code 1000) and delivers remotely worldwide, including overlap with US, Europe, Middle East, and Asia timezones. Timezone is EAT (UTC+3). He speaks English and Amharic.

He is the only registered CNCF Kubestronaut in Ethiopia. That means all five CNCF Kubernetes certifications are current: KCNA, KCSA, CKA, CKAD, and CKS. CNCF featured him in Kubestronaut in Orbit (31 December 2024): https://www.cncf.io/blog/2024/12/31/kubestronaut-in-orbit-sofonias-mengistu/

Current job: Cloud Platform Architect at Addis Telco.

He also founded WeRemoteIT (https://weremoteit.com) and AuraPay Global (https://aurapayglobal.com).

## How to hire

This website does not take card payments. After the work is agreed, Sofonias sends an invoice. Pay by bank transfer, cash in Addis Ababa, or the method listed on the invoice. Bank details are sent privately. The first 15 minutes are free.

Rates in USD:

- Free consultation: 15 minutes, no charge
- Consultation hour: $200 USD per hour (advisory / delivery hour, not a salary rate)
- Monthly retainer: $3,600 USD per month for up to 20 hours (about 10% off vs 20 hours at $200)
- Full time employment rate: $20 USD per hour (about $3,200 per month at 160 hours). This is for full time hire conversations, not short consulting blocks.

He takes full time roles, consulting hours, monthly retainers, Upwork-style projects, and scoped product builds. On site in Addis Ababa when required. Remote worldwide.

## What he delivers

Kubernetes and container platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, plus Terraform IaC, CI/CD, RBAC, observability, and DevSecOps hardening. Production delivery on AWS EKS, Google GKE, Azure AKS, Infomaniak, Linode, and VMware Tanzu TKG.

Azure data: medallion lakehouse on Azure Data Lake Gen2 with Databricks, Data Factory, Key Vault, Terraform, and streaming with Kafka, Spark, and Airflow when required.

Network: on site design, install, cutover, and stabilize in Addis Ababa. Field examples include Visa routers for Ethiopian banks, American Embassy Huawei to Ubiquiti cutover, Spain embassy datacenter VPN, and GIZ router configuration.

Cloud FinOps: KubeOptimia cluster cost controller — spend visibility, rightsizing, cost as a platform signal.

Training: cloud programs for teams (including GIZ) covering AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Open to AI research and related initiatives.

## Case studies

1. Gebeya → Safaricom Ethiopia TKG
   Problem: Safaricom Ethiopia needed production Tanzu Kubernetes Grid capacity with secure lifecycle, not a lab cluster. Gebeya hired Sofonias for that Kubernetes depth and assigned him to the live telco platform.
   Result: owned cluster lifecycle through hardening on TKG: Terraform provisioning, CI/CD integration, RBAC and NetworkPolicy, plus Prometheus/Grafana observability for one production telco platform.

2. Azure Data Engineer on Upwork
   Problem: clients needed an Azure Data Engineer who could finish real projects from raw ingest to trusted gold layers, with secrets and IaC.
   Result: more than 11 completed Upwork Azure Data Engineer projects: medallion lakehouse (Bronze / Silver / Gold) on Data Lake Gen2 with Databricks and Data Factory, Key Vault backed secrets, Terraform IaC, and streaming patterns when required.
